subject: Image 1 is the APPROVED pixel-art style and object-design reference. Draw ONE NEW ISOLATED GAME SPRITE of a small squat irregular GREY BOUNDARY STONE in the same family as the stone left of the little blue traveler in Image 1. Do NOT crop or redraw a landscape. Target entire stone footprint including attached moss about 30 native pixels wide and 41 native pixels tall, small, low and irregular, not a tall elaborate gravestone or stela. Slightly tapered/chipped upper corners, broad roughly vertical front face, narrower visible right side plane and top plane, three-quarter high-angle RPG view. Sparse olive moss cap attached snugly to the top and a few attached moss pixels at the foot, NOT an island of grass or ground. A plain worn rock with only two or three short sparse fissures, NO runes, NO emblem, NO carving, NO inscription, NO face. Cool neutral medium grey material albedo, small darker plane on one side but NO bright yellow lamplight already painted onto the stone. Use broad connected 2-4 value gray clusters, distinct front/side/top planes, 1-2 native pixel dark ink outline. Deliberately low-resolution game sprite with large clean square enlarged pixels, not a detailed HD illustration. Keep the silhouette rooted at one narrow baseline. Outside the entire object must be flat exact bright magenta #ff00ff, NO gradient, NO checkerboard. No scenery, no floor, no cast shadow, no reflection, no glow, no person, no lamp, no text. Center one complete stone with margin. It will receive runtime lighting and a hand-painted surface-normal map, so make readable structural planes rather than baked spotlight shading.
style: Reference-matched low-resolution pixel art: chunky connected colour clusters, quiet restrained palette, strong dark contour, no antialiasing, no dither and no microtexture.
lighting: Neutral even albedo-only material illumination; no warm side light or baked ground shadow.
